whyAfrica.title: Why Invest in Africa?
whyAfrica.lead: Demographic momentum, continental integration, and structural demand create a compelling long-term investment case.

population.title: Population growth
population.desc: Africa's population is projected to reach 2.5 billion by 2050, with 60% under age 25 — driving consumption, labour supply, and long-term demand.

markets.title: Untapped markets
markets.desc: Many sectors remain underpenetrated, offering first-mover advantages for investors who enter with verified partners and local insight.

resources.title: Natural resources
resources.desc: Abundant minerals, agricultural land, and energy potential underpin industrialisation and export-led growth across the continent.

afcfta.title: AfCFTA opportunities
afcfta.desc: The African Continental Free Trade Area unites 54 countries into a single market of 1.3 billion people with harmonised trade rules.

urbanization.title: Urbanization
urbanization.desc: Rapid city growth creates sustained demand for housing, infrastructure, retail, and services in emerging urban centres.

digital.title: Digital transformation
digital.desc: Mobile connectivity, fintech, and digital infrastructure are accelerating financial inclusion and new market access.

platformBenefits.title: Everything you need to invest with confidence
platformBenefits.lead: From verified listings to ongoing monitoring — one platform for the full investment journey.

verified.title: Verified projects
verified.desc: Every listing is screened for documentation, governance, and ground-truth verification before going live.

legal.title: Legal guidance
legal.desc: Access curated legal frameworks, ownership rules, and licensing requirements per country.

diligence.title: Due diligence support
diligence.desc: Structured diligence workflows and verified data to reduce information asymmetry.

ai.title: AI-powered assistance
ai.desc: An intelligent advisor to answer questions, surface matches, and explain regulations.

monitoring.title: Project monitoring
monitoring.desc: Track milestones, financials, and risk notes once you're in a deal.

matchmaking.title: Investor matchmaking
matchmaking.desc: Verified investors are matched to screened opportunities that fit their profile and mandate.

aiAssistant.title: AI Investment Advisor
aiAssistant.lead: Get instant answers about opportunities, regulations, and onboarding — powered by verified platform data.

faqs.title: Answer FAQs
faqs.desc: Quick answers on verification, sectors, countries, and how the platform works.

recommend.title: Recommend opportunities
recommend.desc: Surface screened projects that match your sector, risk profile, and investment size.

regulations.title: Explain regulations
regulations.desc: Plain-language summaries of ownership rules, licensing, and tax frameworks by country.

onboarding.title: Guide onboarding
onboarding.desc: Step-by-step help through registration, document submission, and verification.

sectors.title: Ten sectors, screened end to end
sectors.lead: From renewable energy to agribusiness, every opportunity is verified, documented, and ready for due diligence — so you can move from interest to investment with confidence.

whyAfricaPage.title: Why invest in Africa
whyAfricaPage.subtitle: Demographic momentum, continental integration, and structural demand create a compelling long-term investment case.

demographics.title: Demographic dividend
demographics.body: Africa's population will reach 2.5 billion by 2050. A young, urbanising workforce drives consumption, digital adoption, and labour cost advantages.

afcfta.title: AfCFTA integration
afcfta.body: The African Continental Free Trade Area creates a single market of 1.3 billion people — reducing tariff barriers and harmonising trade rules across member states.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure gap
infrastructure.body: An estimated $130 billion annual infrastructure deficit creates sustained demand for power, transport, digital, and urban development investment.

returns.title: Return potential
returns.body: Frontier-market valuations and growing middle-class consumption offer attractive risk-adjusted returns for patient, verified capital.

about.title: About African Investment Hub
about.subtitle: We connect verified international investors with screened African opportunities — with a trusted ground presence across all 54 countries.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To reduce information asymmetry and execution risk in cross-border African investment by verifying every participant and maintaining current country intelligence.

team.title: Leadership team
team.body: A pan-African team of investment professionals, regulatory specialists, and sector analysts — headquartered across Lagos, Nairobi, and Cape Town.

partners.title: Partners
partners.body: We work with development finance institutions, regional investment promotion agencies, and verified local counsel networks.

trust.title: Trust & verification
trust.body: Every investor undergoes AML/KYC review. Every project is screened for documentation, governance, and ground-truth verification before listing.
